quotes.text: Behold, now it came to pass that when Jesus had spoken these words, ' he looked round about again on the multitude, and he said unto them. Behold, my time is at hand. I perceive that ye are weak, that ye cannot understand all my words which I am commanded of the Father to speak unto you at this time
